monroe.note: Even she, who scolds everyone, has never once found a fault in Marilyn.

Greta has no quarrel with film stars as such, only with anyone who lives as if the planet had no limit. Marilyn's films were made decades before anyone put a number on the world's carbon budget.

musk.note: Rockets and a pile of money, and she wants to know what he has actually done about it.
musk.history: They have never met. Musk's private jet was tracked online by the ElonJet account, which Twitter banned under his ownership in December 2022. Greta has said again and again that the very rich emit the most and must change first. Musk, who sells electric cars, argues that electric cars, solar power and a carbon tax are the answer.

putin.note: A war and a pipeline, and he has never once answered for either.

queen.note: A lifetime of palaces and not a word about the planet.

A few weeks later Greta spoke in Glasgow at COP26 and called the summit a greenwash festival of blah blah blah. The two agreed on little except that talk is cheap.

thatcher.note: The coal and the free market, whatever she once said about the climate.
thatcher.history: They have never met: Thatcher led Britain from 1979 to 1990 and Greta was born in 2003. In 1988 and 1989 Thatcher warned the Royal Society and the United Nations about global warming, and in 1990 she opened the Hadley Centre for climate research. Her government also broke the coal miners' strike of 1984-85. Greta would ask what she did with the warning.

tyson.note: A gentle man with birds; she has nothing to scold him for.
tyson.history: They have never met. Both are vegans, and Tyson has talked openly about how his diet and his love of animals changed him. Greta gave up meat for the sake of the climate and the animals. If they ever spoke, it would probably be about the pigeons.

zelensky.note: He stands up to the powerful, which is more than most grown-ups do.
zelensky.history: They have never met. Greta has stood with Ukraine since Russia's invasion of February 2022. Zelenskyy, for his part, has put the environmental damage of the war, including the 2023 destruction of the Kakhovka dam, before international bodies. They are on the same side of that argument and do not talk about much else together.

zuckerberg.note: Billions connected and a planet still on fire, and he has no answer for that.
zuckerberg.history: They have never met. Greta's school strike grew from one girl outside parliament into a worldwide movement partly through Instagram, which Zuckerberg's company owns. His AI data centres now swallow enormous amounts of electricity, which she would not leave unmentioned. In January 2025 he ended fact-checking on Facebook, which climate scientists warned would let falsehoods spread.

kardashian.note: A brand built on private jets and fast fashion, and she would like to see the footprint.
kardashian.history: They have never met. The Kardashian-Jenner family's private jets drew heavy criticism in 2022 after Kylie Jenner's seventeen-minute flight went viral. Greta Thunberg crossed the Atlantic by racing yacht in 2019 rather than fly, and she keeps saying that the richest emit the most. No public exchange between her and Kim is recorded.

vucic.note: Vucic calls the people asking for accountability a threat to his precious stability.
vucic.history: They have never met. In August 2024 thousands marched in Belgrade against Rio Tinto's planned lithium mine in the Jadar valley, which Vucic's government had backed in a deal with the EU. Greta has criticised leaders everywhere for putting mining and money before people. Serbia still burns a great deal of coal.

sobchak.note: Sobchak keeps discovering nuance exactly where a powerful man should answer a direct question.
sobchak.history: They have never met or interviewed each other. Greta has stood with Ukraine since Russia's invasion of February 2022. Sobchak left Russia in October 2022 and has since interviewed Russian exiles and celebrities on her own YouTube channel. Neither has said much about the other.

greta.note: Brave, and not afraid to be disliked for it.

zelensky.note: A fellow entertainer who walked onto a far bigger stage.
zelensky.history: They have never met. In February 1954 Marilyn flew to Korea and sang for about 100,000 American soldiers over four days, in a thin dress in freezing weather. Zelenskyy, a former comedian and actor, now goes to the front himself to meet his soldiers. Both took an entertainer's gift to people who needed it badly.

zuckerberg.note: An odd young man who connects everyone and seems lonely himself.
zuckerberg.history: They have never met: Zuckerberg was born in 1984. Marilyn was photographed by thousands and could not walk down a street unnoticed. He built the machine that later offered a smaller version of that attention to everyone.

kardashian.note: She understands the camera better than most, and the age of the feed.
kardashian.history: They have never met: Marilyn was already a legend before Kim was born. Kim has often named Marilyn as a style icon, and the platinum curls and the white-dress glamour are part of what she borrows. Marilyn is the original star who was looked at all her life, and Kim turned that into a business.

vucic.note: Vucic seems so occupied saving both his seats that I wonder whether he ever gets to rest.
vucic.history: They have never met: Vucic was born in 1970 in Belgrade. In Marilyn's years Yugoslavia was a communist country under Tito, outside both the Soviet and American blocs. Vucic grew up in that country and later watched it break apart.

sobchak.note: Sobchak asks what everyone wants to know, but I would rather she asked what I want to say.
sobchak.history: They have never met. Sobchak became a household name in Russia as the glamorous hostess of the reality show Dom-2 from 2004. Marilyn is the original blonde sex symbol who wanted to be taken seriously, and Sobchak has since turned to journalism and politics for the same reason.

greta.note: Hardly an engineer, and rather too sure of her sermons.

The Wall Street Journal reported in 2024 that the two had talked regularly; the Kremlin denied it.

Walter Isaacson's biography later claimed Musk had refused to extend Starlink coverage to Crimea in 2022; Musk said he had not switched anything off.

Meta launched Threads as a rival to Twitter in July 2023, and Musk mocked it. Zuckerberg trains in jiu-jitsu and won medals in a 2023 tournament. In 2025 both found themselves on Donald Trump's side of the room.

kardashian.note: She turns attention into money better than any rocket.

vucic.note: Vucic wants an investment before he can decide which table likes my idea.

sobchak.note: Sobchak wants to interview me, which is an excellent starting position for understanding the future.

Russia invaded on 24 February 2022, and Zelenskyy has said he will not shake Putin's hand. When Zelenskyy challenged Putin to meet him in Istanbul in May 2025, Putin sent a lower-level delegation. Both have said in October 2026 that they back three-way talks.

Serbia refuses to join Western sanctions on Russia though it has voted to condemn the invasion at the UN, and its main oil company NIS is majority-owned by Russia's Gazprom Neft. In October 2025 US sanctions on NIS began to bite. In October 2026 Vucic described a tense 2016 meeting in which Putin spoke very quietly and seemed angry.

monroe.history: They have never met. Marilyn's years as a star saw the heavyweight Floyd Patterson win the title back in 1960 and defend it in 1961. She knew what it meant to be a champion whom everyone wants a piece of.

musk.note: A rich man with big ideas; he waits to see what comes of them.
musk.history: They have no recorded history together. Musk's planned cage fight with Zuckerberg in 2023 never took place. Tyson, a real prizefighter, fought Jake Paul in November 2024 before about 70,000 people in Texas. Netflix said 108 million people watched worldwide.

putin.note: A man who has never lost a fight he picked; he keeps his distance.
putin.history: They have no recorded meeting. Putin is a black belt in judo and a patron of combat sports in Russia. Tyson would be recognised in any Russian gym. Neither is known to have said anything about the other.

queen.note: A lady, and he stands up straight in front of one.
queen.history: They have never met. The Queen has kept a royal loft of racing pigeons at Sandringham since the 1880s, and Tyson is a lifelong pigeon fancier. They would find a great deal to say about their birds.

thatcher.note: A tough woman, and he does not argue with one.
thatcher.history: They have never met. In February 1989, while Thatcher was in Downing Street, Tyson knocked out the British heavyweight Frank Bruno in the fifth round in Las Vegas. Much of Britain stayed up to watch.

trump.note: A friend from the fight nights, though he talks more than he listens.
trump.history: Tyson defended the heavyweight title against Michael Spinks at Atlantic City's Convention Hall on 27 June 1988, in a fight promoted by Trump's Plaza casino, and knocked him out in ninety-one seconds. Tyson had fought Larry Holmes at Trump Plaza in January that year. He was then the undisputed heavyweight champion at the age of twenty-one.

zelensky.note: A small man holding a big line; he understands that.
zelensky.history: They have no recorded meeting. Ukraine's heavyweight champions Vitali and Wladimir Klitschko are heroes in the boxing world, and Vitali has been mayor of Kyiv since 2014. Wladimir joined Ukraine's territorial defence forces in 2022. Tyson, a heavyweight champion himself, knows their names well.

zuckerberg.note: A young man who never goes out in the sun, and Mike would like to teach him how.
zuckerberg.history: They have no recorded meeting. Zuckerberg trains in mixed martial arts and jiu-jitsu and competed in a tournament in 2023. Tyson's fight with Jake Paul was a Netflix event in 2024 that millions watched. Zuckerberg knows how much attention a big fight draws.

kardashian.note: A friendly person who is always on camera; he is polite and keeps his distance.
kardashian.history: They have no recorded history together. Both turned fame into a business: Tyson sells his own cannabis brand and Kim sells shapewear through Skims. Tyson's fight with Jake Paul in November 2024 was streamed by Netflix to millions of viewers.

vucic.note: Vucic looks tired, but nobody asked him to carry two tables on his back.
vucic.history: They have no recorded meeting. Tyson is a retired heavyweight champion who speaks softly. Vucic has led Serbia as president and prime minister for most of the last decade and a half. Neither has publicly said anything about the other.

sobchak.note: Sobchak can ask me something quiet if she lets me finish answering it.
sobchak.history: They have no recorded meeting. Sobchak interviews celebrities for her YouTube channel, and a boxer with Tyson's story would suit her. He has been a headline for decades in Russia as elsewhere.

greta.note: A young voice that will not be silenced, and he knows how that feels.
greta.history: They have never met. Greta has stood with Ukraine since Russia's invasion of February 2022. Zelenskyy, for his part, has put the environmental damage of the war, including the 2023 destruction of the Kakhovka dam, before international bodies. They are on the same side of that argument and do not talk about much else together.

monroe.note: The star of a film he watched as a boy, long before any of this.
monroe.history: They have never met. In February 1954 Marilyn flew to Korea and sang for about 100,000 American soldiers over four days, in a thin dress in freezing weather. Zelenskyy, a former comedian and actor, now goes to the front himself to meet his soldiers. Both took an entertainer's gift to people who needed it badly.

musk.note: His satellites keep Zelensky's army online, and neither forgets it.
musk.history: Starlink was switched on in Ukraine in February 2022 after Zelenskyy's digital minister Mykhailo Fedorov asked Musk for it on Twitter. In October 2022 Musk put out a peace plan and a poll, and Zelenskyy answered with a poll of his own asking which Musk people liked more. Walter Isaacson's biography later claimed Musk had refused to extend Starlink coverage to Crimea in 2022; Musk said he had not switched anything off.

putin.note: The man who invaded his country, and he will not shake his hand for the cameras.
putin.history: They met in person once, at the Normandy format summit in Paris on 9 December 2019, and agreed to a prisoner exchange. Russia invaded on 24 February 2022, and Zelenskyy has said he will not shake Putin's hand. When Zelenskyy challenged Putin to meet him in Istanbul in May 2025, Putin sent a lower-level delegation. Both have said in October 2026 that they back three-way talks.
putin.grudge: The war he started costs Zelensky's country another night of sirens, every night.

queen.note: A symbol that held a nation together through the worst of its years.
queen.history: They have never met. When Russia invaded Ukraine in February 2022 her prime minister Boris Johnson became one of Zelenskyy's earliest and loudest supporters and was in Kyiv in April 2022. Britain sent weapons and training, and Zelenskyy has often thanked the British people.

thatcher.note: She told tyrants to their faces, which is what he would like to do.
thatcher.history: They have never met. Zelenskyy was born in January 1978 in Kryvyi Rih in Soviet Ukraine, about a year before she became prime minister. She helped to end the Cold War by deciding in the 1980s that Gorbachev could be talked to. Ukraine became independent in 1991.

trump.note: He needs the help and resents the bargaining that comes with it.
trump.history: Their phone call of 25 July 2019, in which Trump asked Zelenskyy for a favour concerning the Bidens, led to Trump's first impeachment. In February 2025 Trump called him a dictator without elections, and on 28 February they clashed on camera in the Oval Office. They met again on 18 August 2025 at the White House with European leaders, and Trump has swung between blaming Kyiv and blaming Moscow since.
trump.grudge: The shouting match in the Oval Office in February 2025, in front of the cameras.

tyson.note: A champion who is gentle; there are not many of them.
tyson.history: They have no recorded meeting. Ukraine's heavyweight champions Vitali and Wladimir Klitschko are heroes in the boxing world, and Vitali has been mayor of Kyiv since 2014. Wladimir joined Ukraine's territorial defence forces in 2022. Tyson, a heavyweight champion himself, knows their names well.

zuckerberg.note: A platform that carried his message to the world, and a man to stay on good terms with.
zuckerberg.history: They have no recorded meeting. In March 2022 Meta blocked Russian state media in the European Union and changed its rules to allow posts wishing death on Russian invaders. Zelenskyy has used Facebook and Instagram to speak to Ukrainians and to the world in the evenings throughout the war.

kardashian.note: A famous person with an enormous audience, who could be persuaded to listen.
kardashian.history: They have no recorded meeting. Zelenskyy was an actor and television producer before politics, and Kim made her name on television too. Since February 2022 he has used every camera available to ask for help for Ukraine. Neither has said much about the other.

vucic.note: Vucic wants my gratitude at one table and Putin's approval at the other.
vucic.history: Vucic joined the Ukraine-Southeast Europe summit in Dubrovnik in October 2023, where Zelenskyy was a guest. Serbia voted at the UN to condemn the invasion but refuses to impose sanctions on Russia, which Kyiv resents. Vucic has said Serbia supports Ukraine's territorial integrity.

sobchak.note: Sobchak will challenge a comedian all evening but explain a strongman's answer for him.
sobchak.history: They have no confirmed meeting. In 2019, before Zelenskyy's election, Sobchak was reported to have gone to Kyiv; she said she was visiting a friend. A Ukrainian television host later claimed that Sobchak turned down a chance to interview him. In 2024 and 2025 she did interview his former adviser Alexei Arestovich.

greta.note: She wants everyone to log off, and he cannot see the growth in that.
greta.history: They have never met. Greta's school strike grew from one girl outside parliament into a worldwide movement partly through Instagram, which Zuckerberg's company owns. His AI data centres now swallow enormous amounts of electricity, which she would not leave unmentioned. In January 2025 he ended fact-checking on Facebook, which climate scientists warned would let falsehoods spread.

kardashian.note: A reach of millions that he can only respect.
kardashian.history: They have no recorded meeting. Kim is among Instagram's largest accounts with hundreds of millions of followers, and Instagram belongs to Zuckerberg's company. After the 2016 Paris jewel robbery she largely stopped posting her jewels, because the robbers had tracked her through social media. Her fame and his platform feed each other.

monroe.note: A legend of the old media, from before there were feeds.
monroe.history: They have never met: Zuckerberg was born in 1984. Marilyn was photographed by thousands and could not walk down a street unnoticed. He built the machine that later offered a smaller version of that attention to everyone.

musk.note: A rival with a bigger rocket and a louder account, and a cage match he does not quite want.
musk.history: In June 2023 Musk offered to fight Zuckerberg in a cage match; Zuckerberg replied send me location, and they never fought. Meta launched Threads as a rival to Twitter in July 2023, and Musk mocked it. Zuckerberg trains in jiu-jitsu and won medals in a 2023 tournament. In 2025 both found themselves on Donald Trump's side of the room.
musk.grudge: Musk keeps taunting him about the cage match, in front of everyone.

putin.note: A man whose feed nobody dares to moderate.
putin.history: In March 2022 Russia banned Facebook and Instagram and declared Meta an extremist organisation, after Meta allowed posts calling for violence against Russian invaders in the context of the invasion. Zuckerberg was one of the Americans banned from entering Russia in 2022. They have never met.

queen.note: Seventy years of consistency, with never a change to the algorithm.
queen.history: They have never met. The royal family opened a Facebook page in 2010 and an Instagram account in 2013, and Zuckerberg's platforms now carry much of what is said about the royals. She has never commented on him.

thatcher.note: She would regulate him in an afternoon.
thatcher.history: They have never met: Zuckerberg was born in May 1984, in Thatcher's sixth year in Downing Street and the year of the miners' strike. She believed in the free market and in people making their own way. He built a business out of a dormitory room.

trump.note: The best engagement on any feed, and the biggest headache to moderate.
trump.history: Facebook suspended Trump's account after the Capitol riot of 6 January 2021, and restored it in 2023. Trump once said Zuckerberg would spend the rest of his life in prison if he tried to rig the 2024 election, then shared a dinner with him at Mar-a-Lago in November 2024. Zuckerberg gave $1 million to the inauguration, and Meta paid $25 million to settle Trump's lawsuit in January 2025.

tyson.note: A gentle giant with a fan base nobody can model.
tyson.history: They have no recorded meeting. Zuckerberg trains in mixed martial arts and jiu-jitsu and competed in a tournament in 2023. Tyson's fight with Jake Paul was a Netflix event in 2024 that millions watched. Zuckerberg knows how much attention a big fight draws.

zelensky.note: A former comedian who grew an audience of the whole world.
zelensky.history: They have no recorded meeting. In March 2022 Meta blocked Russian state media in the European Union and changed its rules to allow posts wishing death on Russian invaders. Zelenskyy has used Facebook and Instagram to speak to Ukrainians and to the world in the evenings throughout the war.

vucic.note: Vucic wants every audience at once without allowing their comments to meet.
vucic.history: They have no recorded meeting. Vucic's government relies on loyal media and on social networks, and Meta's platforms are among the most used in Serbia. During the protests of 2025 students used Instagram and other apps to organise, and Vucic accused foreign powers of manipulating them.

sobchak.note: Sobchak understands attention, though she prefers a guest list to an open network.
sobchak.history: They have no recorded meeting. Sobchak's channel and the Telegram and Instagram followings behind it depend on platforms like his. Russia banned Facebook and Instagram in March 2022. She left Russia seven months later.

greta.note: No photographs, no brand, and an outfit that has not been updated in a year.
greta.history: They have never met. The Kardashian-Jenner family's private jets drew heavy criticism in 2022 after Kylie Jenner's seventeen-minute flight went viral. Greta Thunberg crossed the Atlantic by racing yacht in 2019 rather than fly, and she keeps saying that the richest emit the most. No public exchange between her and Kim is recorded.

monroe.note: The original, and the one every feed still borrows from.
monroe.history: They have never met: Marilyn was already a legend before Kim was born. Kim has often named Marilyn as a style icon, and the platinum curls and the white-dress glamour are part of what she borrows. Marilyn is the original star who was looked at all her life, and Kim turned that into a business.

musk.note: His posts get more attention than most celebrities, and she respects the engagement.
musk.history: They are not close and not enemies. Kim's former husband Ye was thrown off Twitter by Musk in December 2022 after a swastika post, weeks after their divorce became final. Both are rich, constantly photographed and fond of a headline. No quarrel between the two of them has ever been reported.

putin.note: A man who never smiles for a photograph, and she cannot work with that.
putin.history: They have never met. Kim is of Armenian descent and spoke up for Armenia during the autumn 2020 war with Azerbaijan, which ended with a Russian-brokered ceasefire in November 2020. Putin was the one who brought the two sides to sign. She has never had a public exchange with him.

queen.note: Photographed for seventy years and never once caught off guard.
queen.history: They have never met or spoken. One shares nearly every day of her life with hundreds of millions of followers, and the other has hardly ever talked to the press. The Queen's official Court Circular and Kim's feed are about as far apart as two public lives can be.

thatcher.note: Corrects everybody and has never once asked what is trending.
thatcher.history: They have never met. Thatcher's pearls and handbag were so famous that British papers coined the word handbagging for her way of dealing with colleagues, a brand made out of one carefully chosen image. Kim later built a business on image in a very different way. Neither is known to have said a word about the other.

trump.note: A fellow performer of the loud and the lucrative, seated at the same tables before.
trump.history: Kim visited the Oval Office on 30 May 2018 to ask Trump to free Alice Marie Johnson, a great-grandmother serving a life sentence for a drug offence. He commuted the sentence in June 2018 and later fully pardoned her. Kim has kept pushing for clemency reform since. In 2025 Trump named Johnson his pardon czar.

tyson.note: Famous in a different way, with a following that is not on her feed.
tyson.history: They have no recorded history together. Both turned fame into a business: Tyson sells his own cannabis brand and Kim sells shapewear through Skims. Tyson's fight with Jake Paul in November 2024 was streamed by Netflix to millions of viewers.

zelensky.note: A comedian who became a leader; she respects anyone who can hold a camera that long.
zelensky.history: They have no recorded meeting. Zelenskyy was an actor and television producer before politics, and Kim made her name on television too. Since February 2022 he has used every camera available to ask for help for Ukraine. Neither has said much about the other.

zuckerberg.note: The platform she lives on, and the man who is rarely seen smiling.
zuckerberg.history: They have no recorded meeting. Kim is among Instagram's largest accounts with hundreds of millions of followers, and Instagram belongs to Zuckerberg's company. After the 2016 Paris jewel robbery she largely stopped posting her jewels, because the robbers had tracked her through social media. Her fame and his platform feed each other.

vucic.note: Vucic can turn one photograph into a speech, and none of his ties are a look.
vucic.history: They have no recorded meeting. Kim has Armenian roots and a famous family in Los Angeles, and Vucic has been a politician since his twenties. In 2025 his country was gripped by months of protest, which is hardly her usual news. Neither has said anything about the other.

sobchak.note: Sobchak knows the guest list, but I know when another woman wants to turn my scandal into her interview.
sobchak.history: They have no recorded meeting. Sobchak was long called Russia's Paris Hilton, a society girl turned TV host, and Kim got her start as Paris Hilton's closet organiser and assistant. Both turned being looked at into a business. Sobchak then added journalism and a presidential campaign, in 2018, to the mix.

greta.note: She sounds like the student hecklers who interrupt my account of all the pressure I bear.
greta.history: They have never met. In August 2024 thousands marched in Belgrade against Rio Tinto's planned lithium mine in the Jadar valley, which Vucic's government had backed in a deal with the EU. Greta has criticised leaders everywhere for putting mining and money before people. Serbia still burns a great deal of coal.

kardashian.note: Her audience could make an excellent photograph of my next historic agreement.
kardashian.history: They have no recorded meeting. Kim has Armenian roots and a famous family in Los Angeles, and Vucic has been a politician since his twenties. In 2025 his country was gripped by months of protest, which is hardly her usual news. Neither has said anything about the other.

monroe.note: Even an evening of national sacrifice deserves a place near Marilyn.
monroe.history: They have never met: Vucic was born in 1970 in Belgrade. In Marilyn's years Yugoslavia was a communist country under Tito, outside both the Soviet and American blocs. Vucic grew up in that country and later watched it break apart.

musk.note: A factory investment would make my second table look wonderfully independent.
musk.history: They have no recorded meeting. Serbia has some of Europe's largest lithium deposits in the Jadar valley, the kind of metal Tesla's batteries need. Rio Tinto's mine plan there caused huge protests in 2024. Vucic has told foreign investors that Serbia is open for business.

putin.note: Vladimir understands loyalty, and I would like him to praise mine before I visit the other table.
putin.history: Vucic has met Putin repeatedly, including in Moscow on 9 May 2025, despite warnings from the EU. Serbia refuses to join Western sanctions on Russia though it has voted to condemn the invasion at the UN, and its main oil company NIS is majority-owned by Russia's Gazprom Neft. In October 2025 US sanctions on NIS began to bite. In October 2026 Vucic described a tense 2016 meeting in which Putin spoke very quietly and seemed angry.

queen.note: She makes holding a position for decades look effortless and properly ceremonial.
queen.history: They have never met. The Queen made a state visit to Tito's Yugoslavia in October 1972, including Belgrade. Vucic was born in that country in 1970 and grew up in it. It is a country that no longer exists.

thatcher.note: She insists a negotiator choose a side before she has even heard his figures.
thatcher.history: They have never met: Vucic was born in 1970. In the 1990s, when Yugoslavia fell apart, Thatcher spoke out against Serbian aggression in Bosnia and called for the arms embargo to be lifted. Vucic was then a young nationalist elected to the Serbian parliament in 1993, and he has since said that his views changed.

trump.note: Donald calls every threat a deal and expects me to thank him for the pressure.
trump.history: In September 2020 Trump hosted Vucic and Kosovo's prime minister at the White House, where they signed economic normalisation deals and Serbia agreed to move its Israeli embassy to Jerusalem. Vucic has sought Trump's goodwill since, and Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner has pursued a project in Belgrade. In October 2025 American sanctions on the Russian-owned oil company NIS began to bite.

tyson.note: A quiet champion nearby would discourage anyone from overturning my careful seating plan.
tyson.history: They have no recorded meeting. Tyson is a retired heavyweight champion who speaks softly. Vucic has led Serbia as president and prime minister for most of the last decade and a half. Neither has publicly said anything about the other.

zelensky.note: I can offer sympathy and a drink, provided neither becomes a demand to leave my other table.
zelensky.history: Vucic joined the Ukraine-Southeast Europe summit in Dubrovnik in October 2023, where Zelenskyy was a guest. Serbia voted at the UN to condemn the invasion but refuses to impose sanctions on Russia, which Kyiv resents. Vucic has said Serbia supports Ukraine's territorial integrity.

zuckerberg.note: A useful platform could carry my explanation to everyone who missed the first broadcast.
zuckerberg.history: They have no recorded meeting. Vucic's government relies on loyal media and on social networks, and Meta's platforms are among the most used in Serbia. During the protests of 2025 students used Instagram and other apps to organise, and Vucic accused foreign powers of manipulating them.

sobchak.note: She has interviewed me and knows when a friendly question can become a useful public answer.
sobchak.history: Sobchak interviewed Vucic, and in a long interview published on 20 October 2026 he told her that a world war was almost unavoidable. He also talked about a tense meeting with Putin in 2016. The interview came days before Serbia's early elections on 25 October 2026. She knows his two-chairs routine well and likes asking about it.

greta.note: She mistakes refusing every compromise for having an actual plan for tomorrow.
greta.history: They have never met or interviewed each other. Greta has stood with Ukraine since Russia's invasion of February 2022. Sobchak left Russia in October 2022 and has since interviewed Russian exiles and celebrities on her own YouTube channel. Neither has said much about the other.

kardashian.note: She monetises attention without pretending to be above it, which makes her a useful rival.
kardashian.history: They have no recorded meeting. Sobchak was long called Russia's Paris Hilton, a society girl turned TV host, and Kim got her start as Paris Hilton's closet organiser and assistant. Both turned being looked at into a business. Sobchak then added journalism and a presidential campaign, in 2018, to the mix.

monroe.note: Marilyn is the one guest whose silence would still be a better interview than most answers here.
monroe.history: They have never met. Sobchak became a household name in Russia as the glamorous hostess of the reality show Dom-2 from 2004. Marilyn is the original blonde sex symbol who wanted to be taken seriously, and Sobchak has since turned to journalism and politics for the same reason.

musk.note: An unpredictable billionaire with an audience is an interview worth fighting for.
musk.history: They have no recorded meeting. Sobchak left Russia in October 2022, the same month Musk bought Twitter and published his Ukraine peace plan. She has since worked mainly through YouTube and Telegram.

putin.note: Vladimir Vladimirovich lets me remain useful, and I can surely explain his side more sympathetically.
putin.history: Putin was the deputy of Ksenia's father Anatoly Sobchak, the mayor of St Petersburg, in the 1990s, and he helped to spirit Anatoly out of the country when he was threatened with arrest in 1997. Putin spoke at Anatoly's funeral in 2000, and Ksenia has long called him something close to a godfather. In 2018 she ran for president against him and won about 1.7 percent. In October 2022 she left Russia after a raid on her home.

queen.note: Nobody understood access, composure and the guest list better than she did.
queen.history: They have never met. The Queen's state visit to Russia in October 1994 took in St Petersburg, which was then governed by Ksenia's father Anatoly Sobchak as mayor. Ksenia was twelve years old that autumn. She later became one of Russia's best known television faces.

thatcher.note: Her absolute answers leave no room for a clever qualification or a follow-up.
thatcher.history: They have never met. In the 1990s Thatcher's name was shorthand in Russia for market reform, and Ksenia's father Anatoly Sobchak ran one of the first market-minded city administrations as mayor of St Petersburg. Thatcher had championed Gorbachev as a man the West could do business with, as early as 1984. Ksenia grew up in that world of hopes.

trump.note: Donald mistakes bad taste and a loud sales pitch for an answer, but I still want the interview.
trump.history: They have no recorded meeting. Trump brought the Miss Universe pageant to Moscow in November 2013, in the same Russian celebrity world Sobchak moved in. She visited Washington in 2018 and said Russia and America were slipping into a new cold war. No interview with him is recorded.

tyson.note: His quietness might conceal the only honest answer in the room.
tyson.history: They have no recorded meeting. Sobchak interviews celebrities for her YouTube channel, and a boxer with Tyson's story would suit her. He has been a headline for decades in Russia as elsewhere.

zelensky.note: He will ask why my sharpest follow-up becomes a clarification at the powerful table.
zelensky.history: They have no confirmed meeting. In 2019, before Zelenskyy's election, Sobchak was reported to have gone to Kyiv; she said she was visiting a friend. A Ukrainian television host later claimed that Sobchak turned down a chance to interview him. In 2024 and 2025 she did interview his former adviser Alexei Arestovich.

zuckerberg.note: He owns the room in which everyone else competes to be seen.
zuckerberg.history: They have no recorded meeting. Sobchak's channel and the Telegram and Instagram followings behind it depend on platforms like his. Russia banned Facebook and Instagram in March 2022. She left Russia seven months later.

vucic.note: My interviewee can turn two reserved chairs into a very long answer about having only one.
vucic.history: Sobchak interviewed Vucic, and in a long interview published on 20 October 2026 he told her that a world war was almost unavoidable. He also talked about a tense meeting with Putin in 2016. The interview came days before Serbia's early elections on 25 October 2026. She knows his two-chairs routine well and likes asking about it.
